population.test_split: labels never read; features unused; the test index enters only the row-only router split fingerprint

T1.name: sparse bin
T1.rule: in any outer fold, held-out support x that fold's base rate < 10

T2.name: reversal
T2.rule: pooled lift interval wholly on the wrong side of 1.0 for the intended direction (bins with no intended direction cannot fire)

T3.name: ordering
T3.rule: an adjacent pair inverted in pooled OOF lift and in at least 4 of 5 folds

criteria.note: binning criteria, not routing obligations: the routed-set floors (Pass 1 125, Pass 2 75 rows) are not applied to bins and are unchanged

eb.method: outer fold k: RFFeatureEngineer fitted on the training rows outside k, applied to the rows of k (features only), binned with the thresholds under test through the production binning path; in-sample: one engineer fitted on all training rows (the historical method)

decision.stage2_regeneration: not required by the binning: no revision adopted (section 5.2); reuse of c3_20261112_153333 remains subject to the Commit 4A checks
decision.router_utility: E-B2 is reported; it vetoes only through the fold-0 preflight, which no retained family needs; it is not a decision input

eb2.read: fit-time records and saved models only: per-fold GLASS Pass 1 rules and Pass 2 rule ids (evidence.json), full-train GLASS rules (bundle), RF Router impurity importances (saved full-train forests); no outer-OOF route, Stage 4 or test result
not_recorded: GLASS Pass 2 rule conditions per outer fold (rule ids only)
RF Router per-fold forests (only the full-train forests are saved)

glass_rules.precision_and_coverage: fit-time, on each fit's own training rows

limitations: Every threshold, historical or revised, is a fixed constant chosen with all training labels. Outer-fold cross-fitting does not remove that dependence (section 6.2).

PR 38 recorded the GLASS Pass 2 rules of each outer fold by rule id only, and saved only the full-train RF Router forests: E-B2 has the per-fold Pass 1 rules, the full-train Pass 1 and Pass 2 rules and the full-train forests' importances.
